<!-- Generated by `make docs-gen` from the code. Do not edit: change the code and regenerate. -->

Puts an airport's latest observation on each item, its METAR from aviationweather.gov, with the day's high and low so far as the temperature markets count them: routine reports only, in the local day.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `weather.airport` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead. It only reads, so what fails is tried again 3 more times to begin with, as **Retry** says.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| City (`city`) | text | no |  | One of the cities Polymarket lists temperature markets for: the station its markets resolve by, its time zone and its unit. Or the place by hand, below. One of `Amsterdam`, `Ankara`, `Atlanta`, `Austin`, `Beijing`, `Buenos Aires`, `Busan`, `Cape Town`, `Chengdu`, `Chicago`, `Chongqing`, `Dallas`, `Denver`, `Guangzhou`, `Helsinki`, `Hong Kong`, `Houston`, `Istanbul`, `Jeddah`, `Jinan`, `Karachi`, `Kuala Lumpur`, `London`, `Los Angeles`, `Lucknow`, `Madrid`, `Manila`, `Mexico City`, `Miami`, `Milan`, `Moscow`, `Munich`, `NYC`, `Panama City`, `Paris`, `Qingdao`, `San Francisco`, `Sao Paulo`, `Seattle`, `Seoul (Incheon)`, `Shanghai`, `Shenzhen`, `Singapore`, `Taipei`, `Tel Aviv`, `Tokyo`, `Toronto`, `Warsaw`, `Wellington`, `Wuhan`, `Zhengzhou`. |
| Station (`station`) | text | no |  | Without a city, or in place of its own: an airport's ICAO code, like KLGA or EGLC. |
| Time zone (`zone`) | text | no |  | Whose day is today, for a station by hand: like America/Chicago; empty for the city's, or UTC. |
| Unit (`unit`) | text | no | `city` | city: the unit its markets are in, °F in the US, °C elsewhere and by hand. F or C: that one. One of `city`, `F`, `C`. |
| Reading field (`field`) | text | no | `airport` | Where the reading goes on the item. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on with these fields added, `airport` under the name **Reading field** (`field`) gives. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `airport` | object | The airport's latest observation. |
| `airport.station` | text | Its ICAO code, like KLGA. |
| `airport.name` | text | Its name. |
| `airport.city` | text; or null | The city, when one was picked. |
| `airport.observedAt` | time | When the latest report was made. |
| `airport.routine` | true or false | The latest is a routine METAR, not a special report (SPECI). |
| `airport.temp` | number; or null | The temperature, in the unit. |
| `airport.tempC` | number; or null | The temperature in °C, to the tenth where the report gives tenths. |
| `airport.dewpoint` | number; or null | The dew point, in the unit. |
| `airport.unit` | text, one of `F`, `C` | Its temperatures' unit. |
| `airport.wind` | object | The wind. |
| `airport.wind.dir` | number; or null | From where, in degrees; null for variable or calm. |
| `airport.wind.speedKt` | number; or null | Its speed, in knots. |
| `airport.wind.gustKt` | number; or null | Its gusts, in knots. |
| `airport.raw` | text | The report as sent, like METAR KLGA 241251Z … |
| `airport.today` | object | The local day so far, by routine reports, as the markets count it. |
| `airport.today.date` | text | The local day, like 2026-11-24. |
| `airport.today.zone` | text | Its time zone. |
| `airport.today.high` | number; or null | The highest temperature so far, in the unit. |
| `airport.today.low` | number; or null | The lowest so far, in the unit. |
| `airport.today.highC` | number; or null | The highest so far, in °C. |
| `airport.today.lowC` | number; or null | The lowest so far, in °C. |
| `airport.today.reports` | number | The routine reports counted. |
| `airport.note` | text; not always there | What the city's markets resolve by, when not its station's METARs. |
